snippet.title: Allogloom - Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Allogloom and Play the Demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2644100?utm_source=Youtube&utm_campaign=date

Join Nora in this mysterious and macabre point and click adventure game. Find and collect items to solve puzzles. Talk to peculiar people and monsters alike. Explore Gruesome Grove and beyond to uncover forgotten truths and save the people of her town!
